title: 第六課：他們學校在山上
zh1:
安同：聽說怡君的學校很漂亮。
如玉：他們學校在哪裡？遠不遠？
安同：有一點遠。他們學校在花蓮的山上。
如玉：山上？那裡的風景一定很美。
安同：是的，他們學校前面有海，後面有山，那裡真的是一個很漂亮的地方。
如玉：我想去看看。我們這個週末一起去吧！
安同：好啊！我現在要去學校附近的咖啡店買咖啡。妳呢？
如玉：我去樓下找朋友，我們一起去上課。
py1:
Āntóng：Tīngshuō Yíjūn de xuéxiào hěn piàoliang.
Rúyù：Tāmen xuéxiào zài nǎlǐ? Yuǎn bù yuǎn?
Āntóng：Yǒu yìdiǎn yuǎn. Tāmen xuéxiào zài Huālián de shānshàng.
Rúyù：Shānshàng? Nàlǐ de fēngjǐng yídìng hěn měi.
Āntóng：Shìde, tāmen xuéxiào qiánmiàn yǒu hǎi, hòumiàn yǒu shān, nàlǐ zhēnde shì yí ge hěn piàoliang de dìfāng.
Rúyù：Wǒ xiǎng qù kànkan. Wǒmen zhè ge zhōumò yìqǐ qù ba!
Āntóng：Hǎo a! Wǒ xiànzài yào qù xuéxiào fùjìn de kāfēidiàn mǎi kāfēi. Nǐ ne?
Rúyù：Wǒ qù lóuxià zhǎo péngyou, wǒmen yìqǐ qù shàngkè.
en1:
Antong：I heard Yijun’s school is very beautiful.
Ruyu：Where is her school? Is it far?
Antong：It is a bit far. Her school is up in the mountains in Hualien.
Ruyu：Up in the mountains? The scenery there must be very beautiful.
Antong：Yes. In front of their school is the ocean and behind it are mountains. It is truly a beautiful place.
Ruyu：I’d like to go see it. Let’s go together this weekend.
Antong：Okay. I am going to a café near the school now to buy coffee. How about you?
Ruyu：I am going downstairs to meet a friend. We are going to class together.
zh2:
怡君：歡迎你們來。
安同：你們學校真遠！
怡君：是啊，不是很近，有一點不方便。
如玉：這裡的學生在哪裡買東西？
怡君：在學校外面。學校裡面沒有商店。
安同：吃飯呢？學校裡面有沒有餐廳？
怡君：有，餐廳在學生宿舍的一樓。
安同：前面這棟大樓很漂亮。
怡君：這是圖書館，旁邊的那棟大樓是教室，圖書館後面有游泳池。
py2:
Yíjūn：Huānyíng nǐmen lái.
Āntóng：Nǐmen xuéxiào zhēn yuǎn!
Yíjūn：Shì a, bú shì hěn jìn, yǒu yìdiǎn bù fāngbiàn.
Rúyù：Zhèlǐ de xuésheng zài nǎlǐ mǎi dōngxi?
Yíjūn：Zài xuéxiào wàimiàn. Xuéxiào lǐmiàn méiyǒu shāngdiàn.
Āntóng：Chīfàn ne? Xuéxiào lǐmiàn yǒu méiyǒu cāntīng?
Yíjūn：Yǒu, cāntīng zài xuésheng sùshè de yì lóu.
Āntóng：Qiánmiàn zhè dòng dàlóu hěn piàoliang.
Yíjūn：Zhè shì túshūguǎn, pángbiān de nà dòng dàlóu shì jiàoshì, túshūguǎn hòumiàn yǒu yóuyǒngchí.
en2:
Yijun：Welcome.
Antong：Your school is really far!
Yijun：Yes. It is not very close and is a little inconvenient.
Ruyu：Where do the students here buy things?
Yijun：Outside the school. There are no shops on campus.
Antong：How about meals? Are there restaurants on campus?
Yijun：Yes. The restaurant is on the first floor of the student dormitory.
Antong：The building in front of us is beautiful.
Yijun：This is the library. The building next to it contains classrooms, and there is a swimming pool behind the library.

act:
I. Where Are They?
【目標 Goal】Learn to describe a person’s specific location in Chinese.
【做法 Task】Study the classroom picture and state where Yijun, Ruyu, Antong, Yuemei, Minghua, and Tianzhong are located on campus.
【例】在教室裡面／在圖書館旁邊／在游泳池……

II. Tell Us about the Place You Live
【目標 Goal】Make simple comments about the location and appearance of a place.
【做法 Task】Imagine inviting a classmate to your home near school. Explain where it is, what the scenery and nearby area are like, and what you enjoy doing there.
【例】你家在哪裡？風景美嗎？
你家附近有什麼？
你喜歡在家裡或家附近做什麼？

III. I Want to Know About Your School
【目標 Goal】Talk about school facilities and surroundings in one’s home country.
【做法 Task】In pairs, interview each other about school facilities, scenery, nearby places, and common activities, then report to the class.
【例】你的學校裡有什麼？
你的學校風景怎麼樣？
你常在學校附近做什麼？
cult:
數字禁忌與幸運數字 Taboos with “Four” and Lucky Numbers “Six” and “Eight”
在臺灣與華人文化中，人們對數字的喜好與諧音文化密切相關。數字「四（sì）」與「死（sǐ）」音近，因此常被視為不吉利。許多醫院、住宅大樓或房號會避開數字四，買房、選車牌與電話號碼時也有人刻意避開。

相反地，「六（liù）」與「祿（lù）」音近，象徵順遂；「八（bā）」與「發（fā）」諧音，象徵發財與富裕。因此，尾數為「6666」或「8888」的車牌與電話號碼常受到歡迎，有人甚至願意花費高價競標。

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: S + 在 + Location

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: 在 introduces the location of a person or thing. The basic structure is Subject + 在 + place/location.
blocks.ex:
我們學校在臺北。
Our school is in Taipei.
他在外面。
He is outside.
圖書館在後面。
The library is in the back.

blocks.label: 結構
blocks.text: Locations may be place nouns; simple position words such as 上、下、前、後、裡、外、旁邊、附近; or noun + (的) + position word.
blocks.ex:
我在宿舍裡面。
I am inside the dormitory.
那家店在你家附近嗎？
Is that shop near your home?
游泳池在圖書館的後面，不在前面。
The pool is behind the library, not in front.

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: A common noun after 在 usually needs a position word to become a spatial location; proper place names do not. 裡面 may sometimes be omitted, but 外面 must be stated when “outside” is intended. The reference point precedes the position word. 的 and 面 may be omitted in common spoken forms.
blocks.ex:
他在房子裡面。
He is inside the house.
他在臺灣。
He is in Taiwan.
他在圖書館外面看書。
He reads outside the library.

gps.title: II. Existential Sentences with 有 yǒu

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Location + 有 + N

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: Existential 有 indicates that a person or thing exists at a specific location. The noun is normally indefinite.
blocks.ex:
那棟大樓前面有很多人。
There are many people in front of that building.
我家附近有圖書館。
There is a library near my home.
樓下有一家商店。
There is a shop downstairs.

blocks.label: 否定
blocks.text: Use 沒有 to indicate non-existence.
blocks.ex:
他家附近沒有游泳池。
There is no pool near his home.
教室裡面沒有學生。
There are no students in the classroom.

blocks.label: 疑問
blocks.text: Use 有…嗎 or 有沒有 to form questions.
blocks.ex:
你家附近有海嗎？
Is there an ocean near your home?
學校後面有沒有好吃的牛肉麵店？
Is there a good beef noodle shop behind the school?

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: Existential 有 and locative 在 reverse the information order: 樓下有圖書館 presents existence, while 圖書館在樓下 identifies location. Existential 有 is also distinct from possessive 有.

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Verb Reduplication

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: Reduplicating an action verb indicates a brief or tentative action, or an action that is easy to accomplish. In requests and commands it softens the tone.
blocks.ex:
他們學校很漂亮，我想去看看。
Their school is beautiful; I want to go take a look.
我想學中文，請教教我。
I want to learn Chinese; please teach me.
我想想。
Let me think.

blocks.label: 疑問
blocks.text: Reduplicated verbs can appear with tag questions or auxiliary verbs.
blocks.ex:
請幫幫我，好不好？
Please help me, okay?
我不會做甜點，你可不可以教教我？
I cannot make desserts. Could you teach me?

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: Usually only action verbs can be reduplicated, especially monosyllabic verbs. With separable V-O verbs, reduplicate only the verb: 上網 → 上上網; 做飯 → 做做飯.

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: 不是 + Statement

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: Here 不是 rejects a prior statement, assumption, or impression: the facts are not as supposed.
blocks.ex:
明華覺得那支手機很貴。我覺得不是很貴。
Minghua thinks that phone is expensive; I do not think it is very expensive.
餐廳不是在學校裡面，餐廳在學校外面。
The restaurant is not inside the school; it is outside.

blocks.label: 結構
blocks.text: 不是 may precede either an affirmative or a negative clause.
blocks.ex:
他們不是在樓下喝咖啡，他們在樓下買書。
They are not drinking coffee downstairs; they are buying books.
我不是不來，我週末來。
It is not that I am not coming; I will come this weekend.

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: 不 simply negates intention or action. 不是… rejects an assumed fact and often supplies a correction.
blocks.ex:
他不買包子。
He does not want to buy baozi.
他不是要買包子，他要買臭豆腐。
It is not that he is buying baozi; he is buying stinky tofu.

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: S + 在／到 + Location + VP

blocks.label: Function & Word Order
blocks.text: 在 or 到 introduces the location where an action occurs. The location phrase must precede the main verb phrase.
blocks.ex:
我爸爸在家做飯。
My father cooks at home.
我們老師常到學校附近的咖啡店喝咖啡。
Our teacher often goes to a café near school for coffee.

blocks.label: 否定
blocks.text: Place 不 before 在 or 到, not before the main verb.
blocks.ex:
他們今天不在家吃晚飯。
They are not eating dinner at home today.
他現在不在宿舍看書。
He is not reading in the dormitory now.

blocks.label: 疑問
blocks.text: Use a question word or 嗎 to ask where an activity occurs.
blocks.ex:
你們在哪裡打籃球？
Where do you play basketball?
你妹妹到這家商店買甜點嗎？
Does your younger sister go to this shop to buy desserts?

qs.instruction: Combine the clauses based on the examples.
qs.prompt: 他在咖啡店，那家咖啡店在陽明山山上。
answer: 他在陽明山山上的（那家）咖啡店。

qs.prompt: 他在圖書館，那個圖書館在他家附近。
answer: 他在他家附近的圖書館。

qs.prompt: 他姐姐在那棟大樓裡面，那棟大樓在學校後面。
answer: 他姐姐在學校後面的那棟大樓裡面。

qs.prompt: 我和我的朋友在一家咖啡店，那家咖啡店在學校餐廳樓上。
answer: 我和我的朋友在學校餐廳樓上的（那家）咖啡店。

answer: 他們學校裡面沒有游泳池。

answer: 教室外面有兩個美國人。

qs.prompt: 那個電影很好看，我想去＿＿。

qs.instruction: Use 不是 to complete the conversations.
qs.prompt:
A：你朋友的家在三樓，對嗎？
B：＿＿，他家在四樓。

A：你們覺得這家店的甜點好吃嗎？
B：我妹妹覺得很好吃，可是我覺得＿＿。

A：很多人都說你做飯做得很好。
B：我做得＿＿，我媽媽做得很好。

A：你的照片不多，你不喜歡照相嗎？
B：＿＿，我不常照相，所以我的照片不多。

A：你晚上不想去他家聽音樂嗎？
B：＿＿，我晚上要和老闆吃飯。
